\chapter*{Glossary}
\addcontentsline{toc}{chapter}{Glossary}
\markboth{Glossary}{Glossary}

This glossary collects every word and phrase taught in the book. Pronunciation appears when it differs from the written form; chapter numbers show where each entry is introduced.

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{आभार}}\enspace\emph{ābhār}\par
\small formal thanks; gratitude\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 2.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{आप} \mw{कैसो} \mw{हो}?}\enspace\emph{āp kaiso ho?}\par
\small how are you? (polite/formal)\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 7.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{बच्चा}}\enspace\emph{bachchā}\par
\small child, written after cha is isolated\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 13.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{बहन}}\enspace\emph{bahan}\par
\small sister, written with known signs\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 10.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{बाप}}\enspace\emph{bāp}\par
\small father\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 10.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{भाई}}\enspace\emph{bhāī}\par
\small brother, written with familiar units\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 10.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{दादा}}\enspace\emph{dādā}\par
\small paternal grandfather\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 11.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{दादी}}\enspace\emph{dādī}\par
\small paternal grandmother\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 11.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{हां} \mw{सा}}\enspace\emph{hā(n) sā}\par
\small yes, respectfully\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 3.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{हूं} \mw{ठीक} \mw{हूं}.}\enspace\emph{hū̃ ṭhīk hū̃.}\par
\small I am fine.\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 8.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{कांई}}\enspace\emph{kāĩ}\par
\small what, assembled from one consonant and familiar vowel material\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 6.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{मां}}\enspace\emph{mā̃}\par
\small mother, written with three known units\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 10.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{म्हारो}}\enspace\emph{mhāro}\par
\small my, now heard and read\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 5.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright

\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 12.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{राम}}\enspace\emph{rām}\par

\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 1.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{\mw{राम}-\mw{राम} \mw{सा}}\enspace\emph{rām-rām sā}\par
\small a respectful Marwadi greeting\par
\footnotesize Introduced in Chapter 1.
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
